authorization: Latest user instruction: original fleet job8964643, controller, pinned snapshot and runs immutable; separate evaluation and existing-label pilot recovery only.
protected_inputs: released v3/v4 datasets, checkpoints and manifests
job_order: Evaluation submitted first; pilot controller also detached and submits when PBS permits. No modification of the existing debug-scaling controller.

evaluation.layout: Up to12 independent evaluators, physical flat tile3*grid_index+seed; ZE_AFFINITY_MASK isolates one tile, local xpu:0. First nine completed models; case118 only after its training status is finished.
evaluation.resubmission: Detached controller checks every30s, resumes completed-origin checksums; scientific failure parks affected chain; exhausted allocation/worker budget stops. Queue time excluded. Each seed0 budget includes its grid mixture.

pilots.launcher: One MPI launcher rank, two independent tile-isolated worker processes using xpu:0.
pilots.layout: One MPI launcher rank; independent case500 tile0 and case2000 tile2. Audit existing labels, no Ipopt generation. Training begins per grid after all Stage A gates.
pilots.resubmission: Dedicated detached pilot controller submits at most12 one-hour allocations, every30s while work/budget remain. Existing fleet driver is unchanged.

evaluation.scorer: Unchanged scoring.py and replication completion/merge routines. Reproduce six modes from the first released v4 origin before evaluation.
evaluation.threshold_justification: Frozen-scorer reproduction threshold is the existing fleet protocol, not a comparison of newly trained models.
evaluation.mixture: Equal weights across three selected seed checkpoints; concatenate64 samples/seed into192, retain every cross-seed pair under frozen fair ES. Same fixed per-seed evaluation noise convention as the existing fleet.
evaluation.summary: Mean and sample SD across3 seeds for each mode; separately score192-sample A/D mixture; cross-grid ES descriptive because masks/scales differ.
evaluation.checkpoint_policy: Admit only finished training; copy best.pt and metadata to new root; hash originals before/after copies and before/after evaluation. Never call evaluate_stage_b.prepare, which edits training manifests. A budget-stopped case118 chain may also be admitted after its original controller records a terminal allocation/budget status and every owned job is finished; preserve original status unchanged and record this stop reason.
evaluation.restart: Resume individual solver references and per-origin completion hashes; incomplete origin recomputed; no training updates.
evaluation.finite_policy: Existing scorer permits null for undefined metrics, never fabricate values. Scientific failures park the chain.

recipe.global_fair_ES: All distinct ordered sample pairs within each origin, all 24 hours, original masks and train-derived scales
recipe.exception: case2000 is an explicitly authorized global K=2 pilot, covariance rank8 unchanged; not sample-parallel K8.

training.budget_definition: Startup, training, selection and checkpoint wall time across all attempts; queue wait, data preparation and evaluation excluded and separately reported. Lost attempts conservatively charged a full hour and parked.
training.resume: Atomic checkpoints; exact manifest, model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG restoration; preserve epoch order and counters. Source snapshot and full configuration hashes checked before every worker.
training.failure_policy: Park the affected chain/grid on scientific failure or unexpected worker exit; do not retry a failed optimizer state or relax any audit. Other chains continue.
training.budget_justification: Synthetic step estimates imply about7.8h for six epochs before selection/startup overhead; twelve worker hours bounds the pilot without promising completion. Patience3 and epoch cap6 apply.

pretraining_gates: CPU parity against official Graphkit CLI and independent OPFData conversion
checked cold/warm/graph-roundtrip solves and dual-sign/units perturbation
full Stage A audit and retained pilot prefix
data.threshold_justification: Unchanged existing Stage A protocols and solver checks; no new scientific acceptance tolerance.
data.headline_rule: All risk-calibration hourly components with >=5 positive days, >=5 negative days and prevalence <0.95; thermal components must also be rated. No test-based choice, top-N selection or fallback when empty.
data.generation: Forbidden: audit existing10080-hour labels per grid. Episodes symlink read-only; manifest copied, original source hashes validated against original generation snapshot; audit source hashes recorded separately.
data.parity_scope: Reuse hash-verified subset parity (200), recorded IDs, CPU byte-identical. No new solves or parity regeneration.
data.temporal_audit: Full10080-hour independent physical audit, retained200-hour prefix, source-calendar separation,72 held-out forecast days. No shortened temporal audit.
data.cache_resume: Atomic per-episode embeddings, train/selection only; completed episodes reused after checksum/key validation; current incomplete cache episode recomputed.
data.pilot_gate: Existing gate:200 attempted, >=1 independently valid, hashes verified; failures remain masked. Report every status and valid fraction; WORKER_UNRESOLVED parks the grid. Full Stage A audit remains prerequisite for training.
data.preparation_budget: Carry prior data_seconds forward; maximum21600 seconds per grid total.
data.physics_fix: Mask offline generators with GridSpec.online_gen before conversion/arithmetic; active null/nonfinite values still fail. Unchanged1e-5 physical tolerances.

verification.tests: Recovery unit tests and existing solver/evaluation tests on compute. Pilot job additionally runs existing pilot, multigrid, identity and V2 tests.
verification.stop: Any failed test/audit stops dependent work; source/config mismatch stops. No new dependencies or tolerance changes.

stage1_verdict.rule: User rule: each case30 OFF selected-checkpoint selection ES within or below historical three-seed ON range; otherwise report gap, no added slack.
stage1_verdict.confirmation: One observed exceedance among six planned epoch comparisons; actual persisted epochs reported, not part of this verdict.
